abstract: Immunocytochemical discordance of human chorionic gonadotropin, alpha-fetoprotein and pregnancy specific beta-1 glycoprotein was studied in formaldehyde-fixed tissues of 26 patients with germinal testicular cancer. The cellular localization of these 3 markers has been correlated with the serum markers in the 26 patients. Serum alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin and specific beta-1 glycoprotein were elevated in 15 of 26 (58 per cent), 17 of 26 (65 per cent) and 7 of 26 (27 per cent) patients, respectively, and in 22 of 26 (85 per cent) when all markers were considered. The cellular alpha-fetoprotein was localized in 5 of 26 (19 per cent), human chorionic gonadotropin in 12 of 26 (46 per cent) and specific beta-1 glycoprotein in 9 of 26 (35 per cent) patients. When all the markers were considered 15 of 26 patients (58 per cent) had either alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin or specific beta-1 glycoprotein localized in the cancer cells.
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)および妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク質の免疫細胞化学的な不一致を、胚細胞由来の精巣がん患者26例のホルムアルデヒド固定組織で検討した。これら3つのマーカーの細胞内局在を、患者の血清マーカーと比較した。血清中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は26例中15例（58%）、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は26例中17例（65%）、妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク質は26例中7例（27%）で上昇しており、3つすべてを考慮すると22例（85%）で上昇していた。腫瘍細胞内のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は26例中5例（19%）、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は26例中12例（46%）、妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク質は26例中9例（35%）で局在が確認された。3つのマーカーすべてを考慮すると、26例中15例（58%）で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、または妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク質のいずれかが腫瘍細胞内に局在していた。
